Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41541	<p><code>taskset</code> bilan CPU pinning (affinity) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CPU affinity (pinning) — process'ni faqat <b>belgilangan CPU yadrolarida</b> ishlashga majburlash. <code>taskset</code> shuni qiladi. Maqsad: yadrolar orasida sakrash tufayli cache yo'qotilishini kamaytirish va muhim process'ni &quot;shovqinli qo'shnilar&quot;dan ajratish.</p><h4>Nega kerak</h4><p>Default'da scheduler process'ni istalgan bo'sh yadroga ko'chiradi. Har ko'chishda:</p><ul><li>L1/L2 cache &quot;sovuq&quot; — ma'lumot qaytadan RAM'dan o'qiladi.</li><li>NUMA serverda — boshqa node'ga o'tib, xotiraga sekin kirish.</li></ul><p>Latency'ga sezgir ilovada (trading, real-time audio, DPDK, DB) bu p99'ni buzadi.</p><h4>Ishlatish</h4><pre>taskset -c 2,3 ./app                 # 2 va 3-yadroda ishga tushirish<br>taskset -cp 4-7 &lt;PID&gt;                # ishlab turgan process'ni 4-7 ga ko'chirish<br>taskset -cp &lt;PID&gt;                    # joriy affinity'ni ko'rish<br>ps -o pid,psr,comm -p &lt;PID&gt;          # hozir qaysi yadroda (PSR)</pre><p>Thread'lar uchun: <code>taskset -a -cp 4-7 &lt;PID&gt;</code> (<code>-a</code> — hamma thread'lar).</p><h4>systemd'da (doimiy)</h4><pre>[Service]<br>CPUAffinity=2 3</pre><h4>To'liq izolyatsiya</h4><p>Pinning boshqa process'larning shu yadroga kelishini to'xtatmaydi. Yadroni butunlay ajratish:</p><ul><li>Kernel parametri: <code>isolcpus=2,3 nohz_full=2,3</code> — scheduler bu yadrolarga hech narsa qo'ymaydi.</li><li>IRQ'larni boshqa yadrolarga: <code>/proc/irq/*/smp_affinity</code>.</li><li>cgroup v2 <code>cpuset</code>: <code>systemctl set-property myapp.service AllowedCPUs=2-3</code>.</li></ul><h4>Kubernetes</h4><p>CPU Manager <code>static</code> policy + Guaranteed pod (butun sonli CPU request = limit) — pod'ga eksklyuziv yadrolar beriladi.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Pinning kamdan-kam kerak — zamonaviy scheduler yaxshi. Noto'g'ri pinning (hamma narsani bir yadroga) unumdorlikni tushiradi. Faqat profiling (<code>perf</code>, cache miss, migration hisoblagichlari) foydasini ko'rsatganda qo'llang.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41542	<p><code>chrt</code> nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>chrt</code> — process'ning <b>scheduling policy</b>sini va real-time prioritetini ko'rish va o'zgartirish. Real-time policy (<code>SCHED_FIFO</code>, <code>SCHED_RR</code>) bilan process oddiy process'lardan <b>doim oldin</b> CPU oladi — latency kafolatlanadi. Xavfi: noto'g'ri ishlatilsa tizimni muzlatadi.</p><h4>Policy'lar</h4><p>| Policy | Turi | Xatti-harakat | |---|---|---| | <code>SCHED_OTHER</code> | oddiy (CFS/EEVDF) | default, adolatli taqsimot, <code>nice</code> bilan boshqariladi | | <code>SCHED_BATCH</code> | oddiy | fon ishlari, kamroq uyg'otish | | <code>SCHED_IDLE</code> | oddiy | faqat CPU butunlay bo'sh bo'lganda | | <code>SCHED_FIFO</code> | real-time | o'zi bo'shatmaguncha yoki yuqoriroq prioritet kelmaguncha ishlaydi | | <code>SCHED_RR</code> | real-time | FIFO + bir xil prioritetlilar orasida vaqt bo'lagi (round-robin) |</p><p>RT prioritet 1-99; har qanday RT process har qanday oddiy process'dan ustun.</p><h4>Ishlatish</h4><pre>chrt -p &lt;PID&gt;                      # joriy policy va prioritet<br>sudo chrt -f 50 ./audio_engine     # SCHED_FIFO, prioritet 50 bilan ishga tushirish<br>sudo chrt -r -p 30 &lt;PID&gt;           # mavjud process'ni SCHED_RR 30 ga<br>chrt -m                            # har policy uchun min/max</pre><h4>Xavf</h4><p><code>SCHED_FIFO</code> process cheksiz loop'ga tushsa — o'sha yadroda boshqa hech narsa (hatto shell) ishlamaydi. Himoya: kernel default'da RT task'larga har sekundning faqat 95%ini beradi:</p><pre>cat /proc/sys/kernel/sched_rt_runtime_us   # 950000 (1000000 dan)</pre><p>Bu 5% — tizimni qutqarish uchun. Uni <code>-1</code> qilmang.</p><h4>Qachon ishlatiladi</h4><p>Audio/video ishlash, sanoat boshqaruvi, telekom, past latency trading. Odatiy web servis uchun <b>kerak emas</b> — <code>nice</code> yoki cgroup <code>cpu.weight</code> yetarli.</p><p>systemd'da: <code>CPUSchedulingPolicy=fifo</code>, <code>CPUSchedulingPriority=50</code>.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Haqiqiy real-time kafolat uchun <code>PREEMPT_RT</code> kernel (6.12'dan mainline'da) va <code>isolcpus</code> bilan birga ishlatiladi. Oddiy kernel'da <code>chrt</code> faqat &quot;eng yuqori ustuvorlik&quot; beradi, qat'iy deadline emas.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41543	<p>CFS bandwidth control (<code>cpu.cfs_quota_us</code> / v2'da <code>cpu.max</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> CFS bandwidth control — cgroup'ga <b>qat'iy CPU limiti</b> qo'yish: &quot;har <b>period</b> (default 100ms) ichida ko'pi bilan <b>quota</b> mikrosekund CPU ishlat&quot;. Docker <code>--cpus</code> va Kubernetes <code>resources.limits.cpu</code> aynan shu mexanizm. Limit tugasa — process period oxirigacha <b>to'xtatiladi</b> (throttle).</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><pre>cpu.max = &quot;50000 100000&quot;  -&gt; har 100ms da 50ms CPU = 0.5 yadro<br><br>vaqt:   |---- 100ms ----|---- 100ms ----|<br>ishlash: ##### ........   ##### ........<br>         50ms  throttled  50ms  throttled</pre><p>Ko'p thread'li ilova: 4 thread parallel ishlasa, 50ms kvota <b>12.5ms</b> da tugaydi — qolgan 87.5ms davomida hammasi to'xtaydi. Natija: latency 80+ ms sakraydi, garchi o'rtacha CPU kam bo'lsa ham.</p><h4>Fayllar</h4><ul><li>cgroup v1: <code>cpu.cfs_quota_us</code> (50000) va <code>cpu.cfs_period_us</code> (100000).</li><li>cgroup v2: bitta fayl <code>cpu.max</code> = <code>&quot;50000 100000&quot;</code> (<code>max</code> = cheklovsiz).</li></ul><pre>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/myapp.service/cpu.max<br>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/.../cpu.stat<br># nr_periods 12000<br># nr_throttled 3400      &lt;- necha period'da throttle bo'ldi<br># throttled_usec 98000000</pre><h4>Throttling'ni aniqlash</h4><ul><li><code>nr_throttled / nr_periods</code> yuqori = muammo.</li><li>Prometheus: <code>rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total[5m]) / rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total[5m])</code>.</li><li>Simptom: CPU grafigi limitdan past, lekin p99 latency yomon.</li></ul><h4>Limit va request (weight) farqi</h4><ul><li><b>Quota (limit)</b> — qat'iy shift, bo'sh CPU bo'lsa ham undan oshib bo'lmaydi.</li><li><b><code>cpu.weight</code></b> (K8s <code>requests</code>) — faqat raqobat paytida ulush; bo'sh CPU'ni ishlatishga ruxsat.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Latency'ga sezgir servislarda ko'p jamoalar K8s CPU <b>limit</b>ni olib tashlab, faqat <b>request</b> qo'yadi — throttling yo'qoladi. Yana: runtime yadro sonini to'g'ri bilishi kerak (Go'da <code>GOMAXPROCS</code> ni limitga moslash — <code>automaxprocs</code> yoki Go 1.25+), aks holda 64 thread 2 CPU kvotasini darhol yeydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41544	<p>VM'larda memory ballooning nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Memory ballooning — hypervisor'ga VM'dan RAM'ni <b>qaytarib olish</b> imkonini beruvchi mexanizm. VM ichida maxsus driver (&quot;balloon&quot;) xotira ajratib &quot;shishiradi&quot; — guest OS bu xotirani ishlata olmaydi va hypervisor uning fizik sahifalarini boshqa VM'larga beradi.</p><h4>Nega kerak</h4><p>Hypervisor overcommit qiladi: 64GB fizik RAM'da 10 ta 8GB VM (jami 80GB). Hammasi bir vaqtda to'liq ishlatmaydi. Bir VM'ga ko'proq xotira kerak bo'lsa, hypervisor bo'sh turgan boshqa VM'lardan qaytarib olishi kerak.</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><pre>1. Hypervisor: &quot;VM-A, 2GB qaytar&quot;<br>2. VM-A ichidagi balloon driver 2GB ajratadi (guest'ning oddiy allokatsiyasi kabi)<br>3. Guest OS bu 2GB'ni band deb biladi — kerak bo'lsa page cache'ni bo'shatadi yoki swap qiladi<br>4. Driver o'sha sahifalar ro'yxatini hypervisor'ga beradi<br>5. Hypervisor fizik sahifalarni VM-B ga beradi<br>&quot;Deflate&quot; — teskarisi: balloon kichrayadi, xotira guest'ga qaytadi.</pre><p>Guest OS'ning o'zi qaysi sahifani bo'shatishni hal qiladi — u qaysi xotira kam muhim ekanini hypervisor'dan yaxshiroq biladi. Bu hypervisor-darajasidagi swap'dan ancha samarali.</p><h4>Qayerda</h4><ul><li>KVM: <code>virtio_balloon</code> driver.</li><li>VMware: <code>vmmemctl</code> (VMware Tools).</li><li>Hyper-V: Dynamic Memory.</li></ul><pre>lsmod | grep balloon</pre><h4>Muammolar</h4><ul><li>Guest ichida &quot;sababsiz&quot; xotira bosimi, swap, hatto OOM — VM ichidan qaraganda xotira yetarli ko'rinadi, lekin balloon uni yegan.</li><li>DB'lar (katta buffer pool) uchun yomon — latency sakraydi. Muhim VM'larda <b>memory reservation</b> qilinadi (balloon o'chiriladi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> VM ichida tushunarsiz unumdorlik tushishi bo'lsa — hypervisor metrikalarini ham tekshiring (VMware'da &quot;ballooned memory&quot;, &quot;swapped&quot;). Muammo guest'da emas, overcommit qilingan host'da bo'lishi mumkin.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41545	<p><code>blkdiscard</code> / <code>fstrim</code> (SSD TRIM) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> TRIM — fayl tizimi SSD'ga &quot;<b>bu block'lar endi bo'sh</b>&quot; deb xabar berishi. SSD buni o'zi bilmaydi. TRIM'siz SSD bo'sh block'larni ham &quot;band&quot; deb ko'chirib yuradi — vaqt o'tib yozish sekinlashadi va disk tezroq eskiradi. <code>fstrim</code> — bo'sh joyni SSD'ga xabar qilish; <code>blkdiscard</code> — butun qurilmani tozalash (<b>ma'lumot yo'qoladi</b>).</p><h4>Nega SSD'ga kerak</h4><p>SSD'da ustiga yozib bo'lmaydi: avval katta blokni (erase block, ~MB) o'chirish, keyin yozish kerak. Fayl o'chirilganda FS faqat metadata'ni o'zgartiradi — SSD bu sahifalarni hali &quot;ma'lumot bor&quot; deb biladi va garbage collection paytida keraksiz ma'lumotni ko'chiradi (write amplification).</p><h4>fstrim — muntazam (to'g'ri usul)</h4><pre>sudo fstrim -av                       # hamma mount qilingan FS'lar, natijani ko'rsatadi<br># /: 12.4 GiB (13312983040 bytes) trimmed<br>systemctl status fstrim.timer         # haftalik avtomatik<br>sudo systemctl enable --now fstrim.timer</pre><h4><code>discard</code> mount opsiyasi — muqobil</h4><p><code>/etc/fstab</code> da <code>discard</code> — har o'chirishda darhol TRIM. Ko'p o'chirishda yuk beradi; haftalik <code>fstrim</code> odatda afzal.</p><h4>blkdiscard — xavfli</h4><pre>sudo blkdiscard /dev/nvme1n1          # BUTUN diskni bo'sh deb belgilaydi — hamma ma'lumot yo'qoladi</pre><p>Faqat diskni qayta ishlatish yoki utilizatsiya oldidan.</p><h4>Tekshirish — qo'llaydimi</h4><pre>lsblk --discard     # DISC-GRAN va DISC-MAX 0 bo'lmasa — TRIM qo'llanadi</pre><h4>Virtual va cloud muhitda</h4><ul><li>Thin-provisioned disk (VMware, LVM thin, Ceph): TRIM storage'ga bo'sh joyni <b>qaytaradi</b> — bu yerda u yanada muhim.</li><li>LUKS shifrlash: <code>discard</code> opsiyasini alohida yoqish kerak (xavfsizlik trade-off: qaysi block'lar bo'shligi oshkor bo'ladi).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> TRIM ishlamasligi ko'pincha bir qatlamda uzilishdan: FS -&gt; LVM -&gt; LUKS -&gt; virtual disk -&gt; storage. Har qatlam <code>discard</code>ni o'tkazishi kerak — <code>lsblk --discard</code> har qatlamni ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41546	<p>Linux'da RAID 0, 1, 5, 10 (<code>mdadm</code>) farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> RAID — bir nechta diskni bittadek ishlatish. Har daraja tezlik, sig'im va ishonchlilik o'rtasida boshqacha tanlov qiladi. <b>0</b> — tez, himoya yo'q. <b>1</b> — nusxa, ishonchli. <b>5</b> — parity bilan tejamli, lekin rebuild xavfli. <b>10</b> — tez va ishonchli, eng qimmat. <b>RAID backup emas.</b></p><h4>Taqqoslash (4 x 4TB disk)</h4><p>| Daraja | Qanday | Foydali sig'im | Chidaydi | Yozish tezligi | |---|---|---|---|---| | RAID 0 | striping — ma'lumot disklarga bo'linadi | 16TB (100%) | <b>0 disk</b> | eng tez | | RAID 1 | mirroring — har disk to'liq nusxa | 4TB (har juftlik 50%) | n-1 disk | bitta disk kabi | | RAID 5 | striping + taqsimlangan parity | 12TB (n-1) | <b>1 disk</b> | sekin (har yozuvda parity hisoblash) | | RAID 6 | ikki parity | 8TB (n-2) | 2 disk | yanada sekin | | RAID 10 | mirror'lar ustida stripe | 8TB (50%) | har juftlikdan 1 | tez |</p><h4>Diagramma</h4><pre>RAID 0:  disk1[A1 A3]  disk2[A2 A4]           — biri o'lsa, hammasi yo'q<br>RAID 1:  disk1[A1 A2]  disk2[A1 A2]           — aynan nusxa<br>RAID 5:  disk1[A1 B2 Cp] disk2[A2 Bp C1] disk3[Ap B1 C2]   — p = parity<br>RAID 10: (disk1=disk2) + (disk3=disk4), ular ustida stripe</pre><h4>Nega RAID 5 katta disklarda xavfli</h4><p>Bitta disk o'ldi — rebuild uchun qolgan <b>hamma</b> disklar to'liq o'qiladi (soatlab, hatto kunlab). Bu paytda: ikkinchi disk o'lishi (bir partiyadan, bir xil yoshda) yoki o'qib bo'lmaydigan sektor (URE) — butun massiv yo'qoladi. Katta disklar uchun RAID 6 yoki RAID 10.</p><h4>mdadm misoli</h4><pre>sudo mdadm --create /dev/md0 --level=10 --raid-devices=4 /dev/sd[b-e]<br>cat /proc/mdstat                         # holat, rebuild jarayoni<br>sudo mdadm --detail /dev/md0<br>sudo mdadm --detail --scan | sudo tee -a /etc/mdadm/mdadm.conf</pre><p>Disk almashtirish:</p><pre>sudo mdadm /dev/md0 --fail /dev/sdc --remove /dev/sdc<br>sudo mdadm /dev/md0 --add /dev/sdf</pre><h4>Tanlov</h4><ul><li>DB, yuqori yozish — <b>RAID 10</b>.</li><li>Ko'p o'qiladigan arxiv — RAID 6.</li><li>Vaqtinchalik/scratch ma'lumot — RAID 0.</li><li>OS diski — RAID 1.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> RAID disk nosozligidan himoya qiladi, lekin <code>rm -rf</code>, ransomware, FS buzilishi yoki ilova xatosidan <b>himoya qilmaydi</b> — ular hamma nusxaga darhol yoziladi. Backup alohida. Monitoring (<code>mdadm --monitor</code>, SMART) bo'lmasa, birinchi disk o'lganini sezmay qolasiz.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41547	<p>ZFS zpool va dataset farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> ZFS'da ikki qatlam bor. <b>Zpool</b> — fizik disklardan yig'ilgan <b>xotira hovuzi</b> (RAID shu yerda: mirror, RAID-Z). <b>Dataset</b> — pool ichidagi <b>fayl tizimi</b>; har birining o'z sozlamalari (siqish, quota, snapshot). Barcha dataset'lar pool'ning umumiy joyini bo'lishadi — oldindan o'lcham ajratish shart emas.</p><h4>Tuzilishi</h4><pre>zpool &quot;tank&quot;   (disklar: RAID-Z2, 4 x 8TB)<br>  |- tank/db        compression=lz4, recordsize=16K, quota=2T<br>  |- tank/logs      compression=zstd<br>  |- tank/backups   snapshot har kecha</pre><p>An'anaviy: disk -&gt; RAID -&gt; LVM -&gt; fayl tizimi (alohida qatlamlar). ZFS'da hammasi bitta tizim.</p><h4>Pool yaratish</h4><pre>sudo zpool create tank raidz2 /dev/sdb /dev/sdc /dev/sdd /dev/sde<br>sudo zpool status tank          # disklar holati, xatolar<br>sudo zpool list<br>sudo zpool scrub tank           # hamma ma'lumotni checksum bo'yicha tekshirish</pre><p>Pool turlari: <code>mirror</code> (RAID 1 kabi), <code>raidz1/2/3</code> (1/2/3 parity disk).</p><h4>Dataset</h4><pre>sudo zfs create tank/db<br>sudo zfs set compression=lz4 tank/db<br>sudo zfs set quota=500G tank/db<br>sudo zfs set recordsize=16K tank/db       # DB sahifa o'lchamiga moslash<br>zfs list</pre><p>Sozlamalar ota dataset'dan meros o'tadi.</p><h4>Snapshot va replikatsiya</h4><pre>sudo zfs snapshot tank/db@2026-10-03        # bir zumda, CoW tufayli joy olmaydi<br>sudo zfs rollback tank/db@2026-10-03<br>sudo zfs send tank/db@snap | ssh backup zfs receive pool/db   # boshqa serverga</pre><h4>Boshqa xususiyatlar</h4><ul><li><b>Checksum</b> har block'da — &quot;jim&quot; ma'lumot buzilishini (bit rot) aniqlaydi va mirror'dan tuzatadi.</li><li><b>Zvol</b> — dataset o'rniga block device (VM disklari uchun).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> ZFS'ga ko'p RAM kerak (ARC kesh) va pool'ni kengaytirish cheklangan — mavjud RAID-Z vdev'ga disk qo'shish faqat yangi versiyalarda (OpenZFS 2.3+). Pool dizaynini oldindan rejalashtiring. Litsenziya tufayli Linux kernel'ga kirmagan — DKMS orqali o'rnatiladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41548	<p>Epoll starvation nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Epoll starvation — event loop bitta &quot;og'ir&quot; socket'ga (katta ma'lumot oqimi) shuncha vaqt sarflaydiki, boshqa tayyor socket'lar navbatini kutib <b>&quot;och&quot; qoladi</b> — ularning latency'si keskin oshadi. Yechim: har socket'ga bir iteratsiyada <b>cheklangan</b> ish berish (fairness).</p><h4>Qanday paydo bo'ladi</h4><p>Edge-triggered epoll'da qoida: socket'ni <code>EAGAIN</code>gacha to'liq o'qish kerak. Naiv kod:</p><pre>for each ready fd:<br>    while (read(fd, buf, N) &gt; 0)   // tez client uzluksiz yuborsa — bu loop tugamaydi<br>        process(buf);</pre><p>Bitta client 1GB yuklayapti — loop u bilan band, qolgan 999 ta client'ning kichik so'rovlari kutadi.</p><h4>Yechim — ish byudjeti</h4><pre>for each ready fd:<br>    for (i = 0; i &lt; 16; i++) {         // har socket'ga ko'pi bilan 16 ta read<br>        n = read(fd, buf, N);<br>        if (n &lt;= 0) break;             // EAGAIN — hammasi o'qildi<br>        process(buf);<br>    }<br>    if (hali ma'lumot bor) pending_list ga qo'sh   // keyingi aylanishda davom</pre><p><code>pending_list</code>dagi fd'lar keyingi iteratsiyada epoll'ni kutmasdan qayta ishlanadi — ma'lumot yo'qolmaydi, lekin hamma navbat bilan oladi.</p><h4>Boshqa yondashuvlar</h4><ul><li><b>Level-triggered</b> rejim + bir martalik cheklangan read — kernel &quot;hali ma'lumot bor&quot; deb qayta xabar beradi.</li><li><code>epoll_wait</code>'ning <code>maxevents</code> parametri — bir aylanishda qayta ishlanadigan hodisalar soni.</li><li>Og'ir ishni (CPU-intensive) event loop'dan <b>worker pool</b>ga chiqarish — event loop faqat I/O qiladi.</li><li>Ko'p event loop + <code>SO_REUSEPORT</code> — ulanishlar thread'lar bo'ylab taqsimlanadi.</li></ul><h4>Real misollar</h4><ul><li>nginx: har ulanish uchun buffer va limitlar.</li><li>Node.js: bitta sync og'ir funksiya butun event loop'ni to'xtatadi — xuddi shu muammoning ilova darajasidagi ko'rinishi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Simptom — o'rtacha latency yaxshi, lekin p99 yomon va bir nechta &quot;og'ir&quot; client bilan bog'liq. Event loop lag metrikasi (Node'da <code>eventLoopUtilization</code>) va har ulanish bo'yicha throughput buni ko'rsatadi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41549	<p>Socket buffer autotuning nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Socket buffer autotuning — kernel har TCP ulanishning receive/send buferini <b>avtomatik</b> o'lchaydi: tez va uzoq (katta RTT) ulanishga katta bufer, sekin ulanishga kichik. Maqsad — <b>BDP</b> (Bandwidth-Delay Product) qadar ma'lumot &quot;yo'lda&quot; bo'la olsin, aks holda link to'liq ishlatilmaydi.</p><h4>Nega bufer o'lchami tezlikni belgilaydi</h4><p>TCP ACK kelishini kutmasdan ko'pi bilan <b>window</b> (taxminan bufer) qadar yuboradi.</p><pre>BDP = bandwidth x RTT<br>1 Gbit/s x 100ms (Toshkent - Frankfurt) = 125 MB/s x 0.1 s = 12.5 MB</pre><p>Bufer 256KB bo'lsa: max tezlik = 256KB / 0.1s = <b>2.5 MB/s</b> — 1 Gbit kanalning 2%i. Bufer 12.5MB bo'lsa — to'liq tezlik.</p><h4>Autotuning qanday ishlaydi</h4><p>Kernel har ulanishning haqiqiy tezligi va RTT'sini kuzatib, buferni <code>tcp_rmem</code>/<code>tcp_wmem</code> chegaralari ichida oshiradi yoki kamaytiradi.</p><pre>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_rmem<br># net.ipv4.tcp_rmem = 4096 131072 6291456<br>#                     min  default  max<br>sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_moderate_rcvbuf    # 1 = receive autotuning yoqilgan</pre><p>Uzoq masofali katta transfer (backup, replikatsiya) uchun <code>max</code>ni oshirish:</p><pre>net.ipv4.tcp_rmem = 4096 131072 33554432<br>net.ipv4.tcp_wmem = 4096 16384  33554432<br>net.core.rmem_max = 33554432<br>net.core.wmem_max = 33554432</pre><h4>Muhim tuzoq</h4><p>Ilova <code>setsockopt(SO_RCVBUF)</code> bilan buferni <b>qo'lda</b> o'rnatsa — o'sha socket uchun <b>autotuning o'chadi</b>. Ko'p &quot;tuning&quot; maslahatlari aslida unumdorlikni yomonlashtiradi. Qo'lda o'rnatilgan qiymat <code>net.core.rmem_max</code> bilan cheklanadi.</p><h4>Kuzatish</h4><pre>ss -tmi dst 10.0.0.5<br># rtt:98.5/2.1 ... rcv_space:... skmem:(r0,rb6291456,...)  &lt;- rb = joriy receive bufer</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'p kichik ulanishli serverda (100k websocket) katta <code>default</code> qiymat xotirani yeydi — <code>max</code>ni oshiring, <code>default</code>ni emas. Bufer yetarli bo'lib, tezlik baribir past bo'lsa — muammo packet loss'da, u holda congestion control (BBR) yordam beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance
Interview Drill::Linux::H24 Kernel tuning & performance	idrill-41550	<p>Enterprise Linux hardening checklist qanday?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Hardening — hujum yuzasini kamaytirish: kerak bo'lmagan hamma narsani o'chirish, qolganiga minimal huquq berish, hamma narsani log qilish va yangilab turish. Qo'lda emas — <b>standart</b> (CIS Benchmark, DISA STIG) asosida va <b>avtomatlashtirilgan</b> (Ansible) holda qilinadi.</p><h4>1. Kirish (SSH)</h4><pre># /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/90-hardening.conf<br>PermitRootLogin no<br>PasswordAuthentication no<br>KbdInteractiveAuthentication no<br>MaxAuthTries 3<br>AllowGroups ssh-users</pre><p>Faqat kalit (yaxshisi — SSH CA sertifikatlari yoki bastion/SSM). <code>fail2ban</code> brute-force uchun. O'zgartirishdan oldin <b>ikkinchi sessiyani ochiq qoldiring</b> — o'zingizni qulflab qo'ymang.</p><h4>2. Yangilanishlar</h4><pre>sudo apt install unattended-upgrades     # Debian/Ubuntu: avtomatik security patch<br>sudo dnf install dnf-automatic           # RHEL</pre><p>Kernel patch'lari reboot talab qiladi — rejali reboot oynasi yoki livepatch.</p><h4>3. Foydalanuvchi va huquqlar</h4><ul><li>Har kishiga alohida akkaunt, umumiy akkaunt yo'q.</li><li><code>sudo</code> faqat guruh orqali, <code>NOPASSWD</code> faqat avtomatlashtirish uchun.</li><li>Parol siyosati (<code>pam_pwquality</code>), ishlatilmaydigan akkauntlarni bloklash.</li></ul><h4>4. Tarmoq</h4><pre>ss -tulpn                  # nima tinglayapti? — kerakmaslarini o'chiring<br>sudo ufw default deny incoming &amp;&amp; sudo ufw allow from 10.0.0.0/8 to any port 22</pre><p>sysctl:</p><pre>net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter = 1<br>net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0<br>net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects = 0<br>net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies = 1<br>kernel.kptr_restrict = 2<br>kernel.dmesg_restrict = 1</pre><h4>5. MAC — SELinux / AppArmor</h4><p>Enforcing rejimida. <code>setenforce 0</code> doimiy yechim emas.</p><h4>6. Keraksiz narsalarni o'chirish</h4><ul><li>Servislar: <code>systemctl list-unit-files --state=enabled</code> — keraksizlarini <code>disable</code>.</li><li>Kernel modullari: <code>install cramfs /bin/false</code>, <code>usb-storage</code> va h.k.</li><li>Paketlar: kompilyator, telnet, ftp production'da kerak emas.</li><li><code>/tmp</code>, <code>/var/tmp</code>: <code>nodev,nosuid,noexec</code> bilan mount.</li></ul><h4>7. Audit va log</h4><ul><li><code>auditd</code>: <code>/etc/passwd</code>, <code>/etc/sudoers</code>, privileged buyruqlar o'zgarishini kuzatish.</li><li>Log'larni <b>markaziy</b> serverga yuborish — hujumchi lokal log'ni o'chira oladi.</li><li>Fayl yaxlitligi: AIDE.</li></ul><h4>8. Tekshirish va avtomatlashtirish</h4><pre>sudo lynis audit system                           # ball va tavsiyalar<br>sudo oscap xccdf eval --profile cis ...           # CIS bo'yicha avtomatik tekshiruv</pre><p>Hammasi Ansible role sifatida — har yangi server bir xil holatda, drift CI'da aniqlanadi.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Hardening bir martalik ish emas — golden image + konfiguratsiya boshqaruvi + doimiy compliance skaneri. Har qoidani ko'r-ko'rona qo'llamang: CIS'ning ba'zi bandlari ilovani buzadi (masalan <code>/tmp noexec</code> ba'zi installer'larni) — test muhitida sinab, istisnolarni hujjatlashtiring.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::linux sec::h24 Kernel_tuning_performance

PID 1 esa handler o'rnatmagan signalni <b>e'tiborsiz qoldiradi</b> (SIGKILL/SIGSTOP faqat parent namespace'dan ishlaydi).</li><li><b>Reaping.</b> Ota-onasi o'lgan process'lar PID 1 ga &quot;meros&quot; bo'ladi. PID 1 <code>wait()</code> qilmasa, zombie'lar to'planadi va <code>pids</code> limitini yeydi.</li></ol><pre># Yomon: sh PID 1, signal app'ga yetmaydi<br>CMD /app/server<br># Yaxshi: app o'zi PID 1, handler bor<br>CMD [&quot;/app/server&quot;]<br># Child process ko'p bo'lsa: init qo'sh<br>ENTRYPOINT [&quot;/sbin/tini&quot;,&quot;--&quot;,&quot;/app/server&quot;]   # yoki docker run --init</pre><p><b>Senior nuqtalar</b></p><ul><li>Go'da <code>signal.NotifyContext(ctx, syscall.SIGTERM)</code> bo'lmasa, graceful shutdown yo'q: 10s dan keyin <code>docker stop</code> SIGKILL beradi.</li><li><code>STOPSIGNAL</code> bilan boshqa signal tanlash mumkin (masalan nginx uchun SIGQUIT).</li><li>K8s'da <code>shareProcessNamespace: true</code> bo'lsa PID 1 = pause container, reaping u yerda.</li></ul>	lvl::Senior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker

Sabablar: <code>FROM</code> tag'i siljigan, <code>apt-get</code> yangi versiya olgan, fayl mtime'lari, layer tartibi.</p><p>| Manba | Yechim | |---|---| | Base image | <code>FROM golang:1.23@sha256:...</code> | | OS paketlar | versiya pin (<code>curl=8.5.0-2</code>) yoki snapshot repo (<code>snapshot.debian.org</code>) | | Til dependency | <code>go.sum</code>, <code>package-lock.json</code>, <code>npm ci</code> | | Timestamp | <code>SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH</code> + BuildKit <code>rewrite-timestamp=true</code> | | Build metadata | <code>-trimpath</code>, <code>-buildvcs=false</code> yoki commit'ni label qilish |</p><pre>SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(git log -1 --format=%ct) \<br>docker buildx build --output type=image,rewrite-timestamp=true -t app .</pre><p><b>Senior nuqtalar</b></p><ul><li>Reproducibility = supply chain asosi: boshqa odam qayta build qilib digest'ni solishtira oladi (SLSA L3+ yo'nalishi).</li><li>Pin qilish xavfsizlik update'larini to'xtatadi. Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-42247	<p>Container ichida Go servis CPU limit <code>--cpus=2</code> bilan, lekin host'da 64 core. Qanday muammo bor va qanday tuzatiladi?</p>	<p><b>Mexanizm:</b> <code>--cpus=2</code> = CFS quota: har 100ms davrda 200ms CPU vaqti. Go runtime 64 ta P yaratsa, 64 thread parallel ishlab kvotani ~3ms da tugatadi, keyin qolgan ~97ms <b>throttle</b>. Natija: p99 latency sakrashi, CPU grafigi esa &quot;past&quot;.</p><p><b>Tekshirish:</b></p><pre>cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat   # nr_throttled, throttled_usec o'syaptimi</pre><p><b>Tuzatish:</b></p><ul><li>Go 1.25+: runtime cgroup CPU limitni o'zi o'qiydi (container-aware GOMAXPROCS).</li><li>Eski Go: <code>go.uber.org/automaxprocs</code> yoki <code>GOMAXPROCS=2</code> env.</li><li>Java: <code>-XX:ActiveProcessorCount</code>, Node: thread pool hajmi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqtalar</b></p><ul><li>Ko'p kompaniya latency-sensitive servis uchun CPU <b>limit</b> qo'ymaydi, faqat request (K8s) — throttling yo'q, lekin noisy neighbor xavfi bor. Trade-off.</li><li>Memory uchun ham shunday: <code>GOMEMLIMIT</code> ni container limitining ~90% iga qo'y, aks holda GC kech ishlab OOMKilled.</li></ul>	lvl::Senior dom::docker sec::k1 Docker
Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-42248	<p>Docker registry pull rate limit yoki registry o'chishi production deploy'ni to'xtatdi. Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-42249	<p>Kompaniya bo'ylab container image standartini qanday belgilaysiz (base image, scanning, signing, ownership)?</p>	<p><b>Maqsad:</b> 500 ta servis, har biri o'z <code>FROM</code>ini tanlasa, CVE patch qilish imkonsiz bo'ladi. Interview Drill::Docker::K1 Docker basics	idrill-42251	<p>Multi-tenant platformada boshqa jamoalarning ishonchsiz kodini container'da ishlatish kerak. runc yetarlimi?</p>	<p><b>Threat model:</b> runc izolyatsiyasi = namespace + cgroup + seccomp + capabilities. Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41001	<p>Container nima va virtual mashinadan tubdan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?</p>	<p>Container — umumiy host kernel'da ishlaydigan izolyatsiyalangan Linux process; izolyatsiya namespace'lar, resurs cheklash cgroup'lar bilan. VM esa hypervisor ustida to'liq guest OS ishlatadi — alohida virtual hardware, gigabaytlab RAM, daqiqalarda boot. Container kernel'ni bo'lishadi, millisekundlarda start oladi, kam resurs sarflaydi — lekin izolyatsiya VM'dan zaifroq (umumiy kernel).</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41002	<p>Container izolyatsiyasini ta'minlovchi Linux namespace'larini tushuntiring.</p>	<ol><li><b>PID:</b> process daraxti (container o'z asosiy process'ini PID 1 deb ko'radi).</li><li><b>NET:</b> tarmoq qurilmalari, routing, portlar, firewall.</li><li><b>MNT:</b> mount nuqtalari (o'z root fayl tizimi).</li><li><b>IPC:</b> POSIX message queue va shared memory.</li><li><b>UTS:</b> hostname va domain.</li><li><b>USER:</b> container ichidagi UID/GID'ni host'dagi boshqa UID'ga map qiladi (container root → host'da imtiyozsiz UID).</li><li><b>CGROUP:</b> cgroup ierarxiyasi ko'rinishi.</li></ol><p>(+ 8-chisi: <b>TIME</b> namespace.)</p>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes
Interview Drill::Docker::H17 Docker, OCI & runtimes	idrill-41003	<p>cgroups nima va v1 bilan v2 farqi?</p>	<p>cgroups process guruhlari uchun resurs (CPU, xotira, disk I/O, PID) taqsimoti va limitlarini majburlaydi.</p><ul><li><b>v1:</b> har controller uchun alohida, bog'lanmagan ierarxiya; buffered writeback I/O'ni to'g'ri hisoblay olmasdi.</li><li><b>v2 (zamonaviy):</b> yagona ierarxiya, page cache va memory pressure (PSI) hisobi, ishonchli OOM boshqaruvi, rootless container'larga delegatsiya.</li></ul>	lvl::Middle dom::docker sec::h17 Docker_OCI_runtimes

Interview Drill::Docker::T14 Docker gotchas	idrill-42259	<p>Container'da vaqt zonasi va soat: log'lardagi vaqt host'dan 5 soat farq qiladi, TLS sertifikat esa &quot;not yet valid&quot; deydi. Bu ikki muammo bir xilmi?</p>	<p><b>1) Timezone (ko'rinish muammosi):</b> container'da <code>/etc/localtime</code> yo'q, UTC chiqadi. Server'da log va DB vaqtini <b>UTC</b> saqlash to'g'ri amaliyot; faqat UI'da lokalga o'gir. Kerak bo'lsa <code>TZ=Asia/Tashkent</code> + <code>tzdata</code> paketi.</p><p><b>2) Clock (haqiqiy muammo):</b> container'da alohida soat yo'q (time namespace faqat monotonic/boottime offset beradi). &quot;Not yet valid&quot; = <b>host</b> soati orqada. NTP/chrony ishlamayapti — VM snapshot'dan tiklangan, yoki suspend'dan qaytgan.</p><pre>timedatectl; chronyc tracking</pre><p><b>Senior/Staff nuqtalar</b></p><ul><li>Clock skew distributed tizimda: JWT <code>nbf/exp</code>, TOTP, Kafka timestamp, lease/lock — hammasi buziladi. Skew'ni metrika qil va alert qo'y.</li><li>Container image'ga <code>tzdata</code> qo'shib &quot;tuzatish&quot; — soat muammosini yashiradi, tuzatmaydi.</li></ul>	lvl::Staff dom::docker sec::t14 Infra_gotcha
Interview Drill::Docker::T14 Docker gotchas	idrill-42260	<p>Production'da bitta host'dagi <code>dockerd</code> qayta ishga tushirildi (upgrade) va barcha container'lar o'chdi. Tizim darajasida bunday blast radius'ni qanday kamaytirasiz?</p>	<p><b>Bevosita:</b> <code>/etc/docker/daemon.json</code> da <code>&quot;live-restore&quot;: true</code> — dockerd restart bo'lganda containerd-shim container'larni ushlab turadi. Cheklov: major versiya upgrade'da ishonma; Swarm mode bilan mos emas.</p><p><b>Tizim darajasi (asosiy javob):</b></p><ol><li><b>Host = failure domain.</b> Har servisning replikasi kamida 2 host / 2 AZ da.</li><li><b>Node upgrade = drain → upgrade → uncordon</b>, bir vaqtda N% node, PodDisruptionBudget bilan.</li><li><b>Immutable node'lar:</b> in-place upgrade emas — yangi image'li node qo'sh, eskisini o'chir. Rollback = eski template.</li><li><b>Canary node pool:</b> yangi runtime avval kichik pool'da.</li><li><b>Detection:</b> node darajasidagi SLI (container restart soni, runtime xatolari) + deploy marker.</li></ol><p><b>Principal insight:</b> &quot;dockerd restart container'larni o'ldirmasin&quot; — bu lokal optimizatsiya. To'g'ri savol: &quot;bitta host o'lsa foydalanuvchi sezadimi?&quot; Agar sezsa — muammo daemon'da emas, arxitekturada.</p>	lvl::Principal dom::docker sec::t14 Infra_gotcha

Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-31413	<p>Swarm routing mesh va ingress network qanday ishlaydi?</p>	<ul><li><code>-p 80:80</code> → har node'ning :80 i ochiq, task bo'lmagan node ham qabul qilib forward qiladi.</li><li>Ichkarida: service VIP + IPVS load balancing.</li><li>Kamchilik: client IP yo'qoladi (SNAT), qo'shimcha hop.</li><li><code>--publish mode=host,target=80,published=80</code> — client IP saqlanadi, lekin faqat task bor node'da; global service + tashqi LB bilan.</li><li>Tashqarida odatda LB (HAProxy/cloud LB) hamma node'lar oldida.</li></ul>	lvl::Middle dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm

Interview Drill::Docker Swarm::K3 Docker Swarm	idrill-42311	<p>Siz tizim arxitektorisiz: nega Swarm, K8s va boshqa orchestrator'lar &quot;desired state + reconciliation loop&quot; modelini tanlagan? Bu modelning chegaralari qayerda?</p>	<p><b>Muammo:</b> &quot;3 ta container ishga tushir&quot; (imperativ) — 2 tasi ishga tushdi, tarmoq uzildi. Endi holat noma'lum; buyruqni qayta yuborish = 5 ta?</p><p><b>Yechim — level-triggered reconciliation:</b></p><pre>loop:<br>  desired = read(store)        # replicas: 3<br>  actual  = observe(world)     # 2 ishlayapti<br>  diff    = desired - actual<br>  act(diff)                    # 1 ta qo'sh — idempotent</pre><p>Event yo'qolsa ham (edge-triggered emas), keyingi aylanishda tuzatiladi. Kalit: idempotent harakat + kuzatiladigan actual state.</p>	lvl::Principal dom::swarm sec::k3 Swarm

Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41311	<p><code>terraform plan</code> lifecycle'ini qadamma-qadam tushuntiring.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>terraform plan</code> — &quot;kod nima bo'lishini xohlaydi&quot; va &quot;real dunyoda hozir nima bor&quot; ni solishtirib, ularni tenglashtirish uchun <b>qanday o'zgarishlar</b> kerakligini hisoblaydi. Hech narsani o'zgartirmaydi — faqat reja tuzadi.</p><h4>Qadam-baqadam</h4><pre> .tf fayllar --&gt; 1. parse + DAG<br> backend     --&gt; 2. state o'qish (+ lock)<br> cloud API   --&gt; 3. refresh (jonli holat)<br>                 4. diff: kerakli vs mavjud<br>                 5. reja chiqarish (+ -out fayl)</pre><ol><li><b>Konfiguratsiyani o'qish va graf qurish.</b> Barcha <code>.tf</code> fayllar parse qilinadi, <code>var</code>/<code>local</code>/<code>data</code> hisoblanadi. Resurslar orasidagi havolalar (<code>aws_subnet.x.vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id</code>) asosida <b>DAG</b> (yo'naltirilgan, aylanasiz graf) quriladi. Bu bajarish tartibini belgilaydi — bog'liq bo'lmaganlar parallel (default 10 ta).</li><li><b>State'ni o'qish.</b> Remote backend'dan (S3, GCS, TF Cloud) <code>terraform.tfstate</code> olinadi — Terraform oxirgi marta nima yaratganini eslab qoladigan xarita (<code>aws_instance.web</code> = <code>i-0abc123</code>). Backend qo'llasa <b>lock</b> qo'yiladi (S3 + DynamoDB yoki S3 native lock) — ikki kishi bir vaqtda ishlamasin.</li><li><b>Refresh.</b> Har resurs uchun provider cloud API'ni chaqiradi (<code>DescribeInstances</code>) va haqiqiy holatni oladi. Kimdir konsolda qo'lda o'zgartirgan bo'lsa (drift) — shu yerda ko'rinadi.</li><li><b>Diff hisoblash.</b> Har resurs uchun: kodda bor, state'da yo'q — <b>create</b> (<code>+</code>); ikkalasida bor, atribut farq — <b>update in-place</b> (<code>~</code>); o'zgarmas atribut farq (masalan AMI, subnet) — <b>replace</b> (<code>-/+</code>); state'da bor, kodda yo'q — <b>destroy</b> (<code>-</code>).</li><li><b>Natija.</b> <code>Plan: 2 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy.</code></li></ol><h4><code>-out</code> — nega muhim</h4><pre>terraform plan -out=tfplan<br>terraform apply tfplan</pre><p><code>-out</code>siz <code>apply</code> rejani <b>qaytadan</b> hisoblaydi — orada kimdir nimanidir o'zgartirgan bo'lsa, siz ko'rib tasdiqlaganingizdan boshqa narsa bajariladi. CI'da: plan -&gt; review -&gt; aynan shu faylni apply.</p><h4>Foydali flag'lar</h4><ul><li><code>-refresh=false</code> — refresh'siz, tez (katta state'da), lekin drift ko'rinmaydi.</li><li><code>-refresh-only</code> — faqat drift'ni ko'rsatadi, kod o'zgarishisiz.</li><li><code>-target=aws_instance.web</code> — faqat bitta resurs (favqulodda holat uchun, odatiy ish uchun emas).</li><li><code>terraform show -json tfplan</code> — rejani JSON'da (policy tekshiruvlari uchun).</li></ul><h4>Tuzoq</h4><p><code>(known after apply)</code> — qiymat faqat yaratilgandan keyin ma'lum (masalan yangi ID). Bunday qiymatga bog'liq <code>for_each</code>/<code>count</code> xato beradi: <code>Invalid for_each argument</code>.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Plan'da eng xavfli belgi — <code>-/+</code> (<b>replace</b>): DB yoki disk o'chib qayta yaratiladi, ma'lumot yo'qoladi. Review'da avval shuni qidiring; kritik resurslarga <code>lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }</code> qo'ying.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41312	<p>Terraform graph cycle nima va qanday hal qilinadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Cycle — resurslar <b>bir-biriga aylana</b> bo'lib bog'langan: A uchun B kerak, B uchun A. Terraform qaysi birini birinchi yaratishni bilmaydi va <code>Error: Cycle: aws_security_group.a, aws_security_group.b</code> beradi. Yechim — aylanani <b>buzish</b>: bog'lanishni alohida resursga chiqarish.</p><h4>Klassik misol</h4><p>App SG DB'ga, DB SG App'dan trafikka ruxsat beradi:</p><pre>resource &quot;aws_security_group&quot; &quot;app&quot; {<br>  egress { security_groups = [aws_security_group.db.id] }   # app -&gt; db<br>}<br>resource &quot;aws_security_group&quot; &quot;db&quot; {<br>  ingress { security_groups = [aws_security_group.app.id] } # db &lt;- app<br>}</pre><p><code>app</code> uchun <code>db.id</code> kerak, <code>db</code> uchun <code>app.id</code> kerak — cycle.</p><h4>Yechim: qoidalarni alohida resursga chiqarish</h4><pre>resource &quot;aws_security_group&quot; &quot;app&quot; { name = &quot;app&quot; }<br>resource &quot;aws_security_group&quot; &quot;db&quot;  { name = &quot;db&quot; }<br><br>resource &quot;aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule&quot; &quot;db_from_app&quot; {<br>  security_group_id            = aws_security_group.db.id<br>  referenced_security_group_id = aws_security_group.app.id<br>  from_port   = 5432<br>  to_port     = 5432<br>  ip_protocol = &quot;tcp&quot;<br>}</pre><p>Endi tartib: ikkala SG (bog'liqliksiz) -&gt; keyin qoida (ikkalasiga bog'liq). Aylana yo'q.</p><h4>Cycle'ni topish</h4><pre>terraform graph -type=plan | dot -Tsvg &gt; graph.svg</pre><p>Xato xabari aylanadagi resurslarni sanaydi — shu zanjirni grafda kuzating.</p><h4>Boshqa odatiy sabablar</h4><ul><li><b>Modullar orasida</b>: A modul output'i B ga, B output'i A ga kiradi. Yechim: umumiy qismni uchinchi modulga chiqarish.</li><li><b><code>depends_on</code> ortiqcha</b> — keraksiz qo'lda bog'liqlik aylana hosil qiladi.</li><li><b><code>create_before_destroy</code></b> bilan aralash lifecycle — bog'liq resurslarda ham kerak bo'ladi.</li><li>Provider konfiguratsiyasi shu konfiguratsiyada yaratilayotgan resursga bog'liq (masalan EKS klaster va uning <code>kubernetes</code> provider'i) — alohida state'ga ajratish yaxshiroq.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Inline blok (<code>ingress {}</code> SG ichida) va alohida qoida resurslarini <b>aralashtirmang</b> — ular bir-birini o'chirib tashlaydi va har plan'da farq chiqadi. Bitta usulni tanlang, afzali alohida resurslar.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41313	<p>Terraform bilan ASG'da zero-downtime AMI yangilashni qanday qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Yangi AMI bilan <b>yangi launch template versiyasi</b> yaratiladi, ASG esa <b>instance refresh</b> orqali eski server'larni bosqichma-bosqich (rolling) yangisiga almashtiradi — har doim yetarli sog'lom server ishlab turadi. Terraform faqat template va ASG sozlamasini yangilaydi, almashtirishni AWS bajaradi.</p><h4>Kod</h4><pre>resource &quot;aws_launch_template&quot; &quot;app&quot; {<br>  name_prefix   = &quot;app-&quot;<br>  image_id      = var.ami_id           # yangi AMI = yangi versiya<br>  instance_type = &quot;t3.medium&quot;<br>  lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }<br>}<br><br>resource &quot;aws_autoscaling_group&quot; &quot;app&quot; {<br>  min_size            = 3<br>  max_size            = 6<br>  vpc_zone_identifier = var.subnets<br>  target_group_arns   = [aws_lb_target_group.app.arn]<br>  health_check_type   = &quot;ELB&quot;           # EC2 emas — ilova haqiqatan javob beradimi<br>  health_check_grace_period = 120<br><br>  launch_template {<br>    id      = aws_launch_template.app.id<br>    version = aws_launch_template.app.latest_version<br>  }<br><br>  instance_refresh {<br>    strategy = &quot;Rolling&quot;<br>    preferences {<br>      min_healthy_percentage = 90       # har doim kamida 90% sog'lom<br>      instance_warmup        = 120      # yangi server tayyor bo'lishini kutish<br>      auto_rollback          = true     # yangi server'lar yiqilsa — qaytarish<br>    }<br>  }<br>}</pre><h4>Nima bo'ladi</h4><ol><li><code>ami_id</code> o'zgaradi -&gt; <code>terraform apply</code> -&gt; launch template'ning yangi versiyasi.</li><li>ASG template versiyasi o'zgarganini ko'radi -&gt; instance refresh boshlanadi.</li><li>AWS eski server'larni partiyalab almashtiradi: yangi server ishga tushadi -&gt; ALB health check'dan o'tadi -&gt; warmup -&gt; eskisi to'xtatiladi (ALB <b>connection draining</b> bilan joriy so'rovlarni tugatadi).</li><li>Yangi server'lar health check'dan o'tmasa — refresh to'xtaydi va <code>auto_rollback</code> eski versiyaga qaytaradi.</li></ol><h4>Muhim tafsilotlar</h4><ul><li><code>health_check_type = &quot;ELB&quot;</code> — busiz ASG faqat &quot;VM ishlayaptimi&quot;ni tekshiradi, ilova buzuq bo'lsa ham &quot;sog'lom&quot; deydi.</li><li><code>deregistration_delay</code> (target group) — so'rovlar tugashi uchun vaqt (masalan 30s).</li><li>Terraform <code>apply</code> refresh <b>tugashini kutmaydi</b> — CI'da <code>aws autoscaling describe-instance-refreshes</code> bilan holatni tekshiring.</li><li>Muqobil: blue/green — ikkita ASG, ALB listener'ni almashtirish. Tezroq rollback, lekin vaqtincha 2x resurs.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Haqiqiy zero-downtime ilovaga ham bog'liq: graceful shutdown (<code>SIGTERM</code>da yangi so'rov qabul qilmay, joriylarni tugatish) va DB migratsiyalari eski va yangi versiya bilan bir vaqtda ishlashi (expand/contract). Infra to'g'ri, ilova esa <code>SIGTERM</code>da darhol o'lsa — baribir 5xx bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41314	<p>HCL'da <code>lookup()</code>, <code>try()</code> va <code>can()</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Uchalasi ham &quot;qiymat bo'lmasa yoki xato bo'lsa nima qilish&quot; uchun. <b><code>lookup</code></b> — map'dan kalit bo'yicha olish, yo'q bo'lsa default. <b><code>try</code></b> — bir nechta ifodani sinab, <b>birinchi xatosizini</b> qaytaradi. <b><code>can</code></b> — ifoda xatosizmi yoki yo'qmi, <b><code>true/false</code></b> qaytaradi (validatsiya uchun).</p><h4>lookup — map'dan default bilan</h4><pre>variable &quot;instance_types&quot; {<br>  default = { dev = &quot;t3.small&quot;, prod = &quot;m5.large&quot; }<br>}<br>locals {<br>  type = lookup(var.instance_types, var.env, &quot;t3.micro&quot;)<br>}</pre><p><code>env = &quot;staging&quot;</code> bo'lsa — kalit yo'q, <code>&quot;t3.micro&quot;</code>. Faqat <b>bir darajali</b> map uchun. Zamonaviy Terraform'da ko'pincha <code>var.instance_types[var.env]</code> yoki <code>try</code> bilan almashtiriladi.</p><h4>try — xatoga chidamli o'qish</h4><p>Chuqur ichki tuzilma, ba'zi maydonlar bo'lmasligi mumkin:</p><pre>locals {<br>  # settings.network.cidr yo'q bo'lsa — default<br>  cidr = try(var.settings.network.cidr, &quot;10.0.0.0/16&quot;)<br><br>  # turli formatdagi input'ni normallashtirish: string yoki list<br>  subnets = try(tolist(var.subnets), [var.subnets])<br>}</pre><p><code>try</code> faqat <b>dinamik</b> xatolarni (yo'q atribut, tur o'zgartirish) ushlaydi. Sintaksis xatosi yoki noto'g'ri resurs nomi baribir xato beradi.</p><h4>can — validatsiya</h4><pre>variable &quot;cidr&quot; {<br>  type = string<br>  validation {<br>    condition     = can(cidrhost(var.cidr, 0))<br>    error_message = &quot;cidr to'g'ri CIDR bo'lishi kerak, masalan 10.0.0.0/16.&quot;<br>  }<br>}<br><br>variable &quot;name&quot; {<br>  validation {<br>    condition     = can(regex(&quot;^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,30}$&quot;, var.name))<br>    error_message = &quot;Faqat kichik harf, raqam va '-'.&quot;<br>  }<br>}</pre><p><code>cidrhost</code> xato bersa <code>can</code> <code>false</code> qaytaradi — validatsiya chiroyli xabar bilan to'xtaydi.</p><h4>Qisqa jadval</h4><p>| Funksiya | Qaytaradi | Qachon | |---|---|---| | <code>lookup(m, k, d)</code> | qiymat yoki default | oddiy map, kalit bo'lmasligi mumkin | | <code>try(a, b, ...)</code> | birinchi xatosiz qiymat | ichki tuzilma, tur farqi | | <code>can(expr)</code> | <code>bool</code> | <code>validation</code>, shart |</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> <code>try</code>ni ortiqcha ishlatmang — u haqiqiy xatolarni (masalan nomni noto'g'ri yozish natijasida yo'q atribut) jimgina default'ga aylantiradi va bug yashirinadi. Kutilgan &quot;yo'qlik&quot; uchun <code>optional()</code> atributli <code>object</code> turi aniqroq.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41315	<p>OpenTofu'da variable'larni erta baholash (early evaluation) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Terraform'da <code>backend</code> va <code>module source</code> bloklari variable'larni qabul qilmaydi — ular <code>init</code> vaqtida, variable'lar hisoblanishidan <b>oldin</b> o'qiladi. Resurs atributlari va <code>data</code> source'lari — yo'q (ular apply vaqtida ma'lum). Qiymat <code>init</code>da berilishi kerak, aks holda xato.</p><h4>Qachon foydali</h4><ul><li>Ko'p muhit (dev/stage/prod) bitta kod bilan, faqat <code>tfvars</code> farqi.</li><li>Modul versiyasini markazdan boshqarish.</li><li>Terragrunt'siz soddaroq tuzilma.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bu OpenTofu'ga xos — Terraform bilan <b>mos emas</b>. Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41317	<p>Terragrunt <code>dependency</code> bloki nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>dependency</code> bloki — bir Terragrunt modulining boshqa modul <b>output'lariga</b> muhtojligini e'lon qiladi. Ko'pincha CI'da faqat o'zgargan modullar apply qilinadi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bog'liqlik grafini sayoz saqlang. VPC kabi kam o'zgaradigan &quot;poydevor&quot; qatlami yuqorida; tez-tez o'zgaradigan ilova qatlamlari pastda. Chuqur zanjir = har kichik o'zgarishda uzoq va xavfli <code>run-all</code>.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt

Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41319	<p>CI/CD'da avtomatik Terraform drift detection'ni qanday qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Drift — real infratuzilma kodda yozilganidan <b>farq qilishi</b> (kimdir konsolda qo'lda o'zgartirgan, avtomatik jarayon yoki boshqa vosita tegingan). Aniqlash: jadval bo'yicha (masalan har kecha) CI'da <code>terraform plan -detailed-exitcode</code> ishga tushiriladi; exit code <code>2</code> bo'lsa — drift bor, alert yuboriladi.</p><h4>Exit code'lar</h4><pre>terraform plan -detailed-exitcode -lock=false -no-color -input=false</pre><p>| Kod | Ma'nosi | Harakat | |---|---|---| | 0 | farq yo'q | hech narsa | | 1 | <b>xato</b> (auth, API, sintaksis) | pipeline'ni yiqitish, tekshirish | | 2 | <b>farq bor</b> | Slack/Jira alert | <code>-lock=false</code> — faqat o'qiyapmiz, boshqa ishlayotgan apply'larni bloklamaylik.</p><h4>GitHub Actions misoli</h4><pre>on:<br>  schedule: [{ cron: &quot;0 3 * * *&quot; }]   # har kecha 03:00<br>jobs:<br>  drift:<br>    strategy:<br>      matrix: { stack: [network, eks, rds] }<br>    steps:<br>      - uses: actions/checkout@v4<br>      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3<br>      - run: terraform -chdir=stacks/${{ matrix.stack }} init -input=false<br>      - id: plan<br>        run: |<br>          set +e<br>          terraform -chdir=stacks/${{ matrix.stack }} plan -detailed-exitcode -lock=false -no-color &gt; plan.txt<br>          echo &quot;code=$?&quot; &gt;&gt; $GITHUB_OUTPUT<br>      - if: steps.plan.outputs.code == '2'<br>        run: ./notify-slack.sh &quot;Drift: ${{ matrix.stack }}&quot; plan.txt<br>      - if: steps.plan.outputs.code == '1'<br>        run: exit 1</pre><p>Auth — OIDC orqali <b>faqat o'qish</b> huquqli rol.</p><h4>Drift topilgandan keyin</h4><p>Ikki yo'l:</p><ol><li><b>O'zgarish noto'g'ri</b> — <code>terraform apply</code> bilan kod holatiga qaytarish.</li><li><b>O'zgarish to'g'ri</b> (masalan favqulodda tuzatish) — kodga kiritish, keyin plan toza bo'ladi.</li></ol><p>Faqat refresh'ni ko'rish: <code>terraform plan -refresh-only</code>.</p><h4>Shovqin muammosi</h4><p>Ba'zi atributlar doim farq ko'rsatadi (AWS tag tartibi, avtomatik qo'shilgan qiymatlar). Yechim:</p><pre>lifecycle { ignore_changes = [tags[&quot;LastScanned&quot;]] }</pre><p>Shovqinli alert'ni hech kim o'qimaydi — avval tozalang.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Aniqlash — yarim yechim. Asosiysi — <b>oldini olish</b>: production'da konsol orqali yozish huquqini olib tashlash (faqat read-only + break-glass rol), barcha o'zgarishlar PR orqali. Spacelift, TF Cloud, env0 drift detection'ni tayyor xizmat sifatida beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41320	<p>Terratest bilan Terraform modulini Go'da qanday test qilasiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Terratest — Go kutubxonasi: Terraform modulini <b>haqiqiy cloud'da</b> deploy qiladi, natijani tekshiradi (output, API, HTTP), keyin hammasini o'chiradi. Bu integration test — &quot;kod sintaktik to'g'ri&quot; emas, &quot;haqiqatan ishlaydigan infra yaratadimi&quot; degan savolga javob.</p><h4>Test</h4><pre>package test<br><br>import (<br>    &quot;testing&quot;<br><br>    &quot;github.com/gruntwork-io/terratest/modules/aws&quot;<br>    &quot;github.com/gruntwork-io/terratest/modules/random&quot;<br>    &quot;github.com/gruntwork-io/terratest/modules/terraform&quot;<br>    &quot;github.com/stretchr/testify/assert&quot;<br>)<br><br>func TestVpcModule(t *testing.T) {<br>    t.Parallel()<br>    region := &quot;eu-west-1&quot;<br>    name := &quot;test-vpc-&quot; + random.UniqueId()   // parallel testlar to'qnashmasin<br><br>    opts := terraform.WithDefaultRetryableErrors(t, &amp;terraform.Options{<br>        TerraformDir: &quot;../modules/vpc&quot;,<br>        Vars: map[string]interface{}{<br>            &quot;name&quot;:       name,<br>            &quot;cidr_block&quot;: &quot;10.0.0.0/16&quot;,<br>        },<br>        EnvVars: map[string]string{&quot;AWS_DEFAULT_REGION&quot;: region},<br>    })<br><br>    defer terraform.Destroy(t, opts)          // test yiqilsa ham tozalash<br>    terraform.InitAndApply(t, opts)<br><br>    vpcID := terraform.Output(t, opts, &quot;vpc_id&quot;)<br>    assert.NotEmpty(t, vpcID)<br><br>    subnets := aws.GetSubnetsForVpc(t, vpcID, region)<br>    assert.Equal(t, 3, len(subnets))          // haqiqiy AWS API orqali tekshirish<br>}</pre><pre>cd test &amp;&amp; go test -v -timeout 30m</pre><h4>Qismlar</h4><ul><li><b><code>WithDefaultRetryableErrors</code></b> — cloud'ning vaqtinchalik xatolarida (rate limit, eventual consistency) qayta urinish.</li><li><b><code>random.UniqueId()</code></b> — har test o'z nomi bilan; parallel ishlaganda konflikt yo'q.</li><li><b><code>defer terraform.Destroy</code></b> — <code>InitAndApply</code>dan <b>oldin</b> yoziladi, test yiqilsa ham resurslar o'chadi.</li><li><b><code>-timeout 30m</code></b> — Go default 10 daqiqa; EKS/RDS yaratish undan uzoq.</li><li>Tekshiruv faqat output'ga emas — haqiqiy holatga: AWS API, HTTP so'rov (<code>http_helper.HttpGetWithRetry</code>), SSH.</li></ul><h4>Xavfsizlik va narx</h4><ul><li><b>Alohida sandbox akkaunt</b> — test production'ga hech qachon tegmasin.</li><li>Tozalanmay qolgan resurslar uchun kunlik <b>aws-nuke</b> / cloud-nuke.</li><li>Har test real pul — PR'da faqat o'zgargan modul testlari, to'liq to'plam kechasi.</li></ul><h4>Test piramidasi</h4><ol><li><code>terraform validate</code>, <code>tflint</code> — soniyalar, bepul.</li><li><code>terraform test</code> (native, 1.6+) yoki plan-asosidagi testlar — tez, mock provider bilan.</li><li>Terratest — daqiqalar, pul, lekin eng ishonchli.</li></ol><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Terratest modul <b>kutubxonasi</b> (ko'p jamoa ishlatadigan umumiy modullar) uchun arziydi. Bir martalik &quot;live&quot; konfiguratsiya uchun ko'pincha policy check + plan review yetarli. Stage bo'linishi (<code>test_structure.RunTestStage</code>) bilan deploy'ni bir marta qilib, tekshiruvlarni qayta-qayta ishga tushirish dasturlashni tezlashtiradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt

Qoida buzilsa, pipeline apply'dan <b>oldin</b> to'xtaydi.</p><h4>Oqim</h4><pre>terraform plan -out=tfplan<br>terraform show -json tfplan &gt; tfplan.json<br>conftest test tfplan.json -p policy/<br>  -&gt; FAIL bo'lsa pipeline to'xtaydi, apply bo'lmaydi</pre><p>Nega plan, kod emas: plan'da <b>yakuniy hisoblangan</b> qiymatlar bor (variable, modul, <code>for_each</code>dan keyin). Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41322	<p>OpenTofu provider imzosini tekshirish nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>init</code> paytida OpenTofu provider binary'sini yuklab oladi va uni ishga tushirishdan oldin ikki narsani tekshiradi: <b>SHA256 checksum</b> (fayl buzilmagan, almashtirilmagan) va <b>GPG imzo</b> (fayl haqiqatan provider muallifidan). Bu <b>supply chain</b> hujumlaridan himoya — provider sizning cloud kalitlaringiz bilan ishlaydi, soxta provider hammasini o'g'irlashi mumkin.</p><h4>Nega muhim</h4><p>Provider — oddiy bajariluvchi dastur. <code>terraform apply</code> paytida u <code>AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY</code> ga to'liq kiradi. Registry yoki tarmoq buzilsa va soxta binary yetkazilsa — hujumchi infra'ga to'liq egalik qiladi.</p><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><ol><li>Registry provider uchun: yuklash URL, <code>SHA256SUMS</code> fayli va uning <b>imzosi</b>, imzolovchining public key'ini beradi.</li><li>OpenTofu <code>SHA256SUMS</code> imzosini public key bilan tekshiradi.</li><li>Yuklangan zip hash'ini <code>SHA256SUMS</code>dagi qiymat bilan solishtiradi.</li><li>Mos kelmasa — <code>init</code> xato bilan to'xtaydi.</li></ol><h4>Lock fayl — ikkinchi himoya qatlami</h4><pre># .terraform.lock.hcl  (Git'ga commit qilinadi!)<br>provider &quot;registry.opentofu.org/hashicorp/aws&quot; {<br>  version     = &quot;5.70.0&quot;<br>  constraints = &quot;~&gt; 5.0&quot;<br>  hashes = [<br>    &quot;h1:abc...=&quot;,<br>    &quot;zh:def...&quot;,<br>  ]<br>}</pre><p>Birinchi <code>init</code> hash'larni yozadi. Keyingi har <code>init</code> (boshqa kompyuter, CI) aynan shu hash'ni talab qiladi — kimdir registry'da shu versiyani almashtirsa ham, yuklash rad etiladi.</p><p>Ko'p platforma uchun (dasturchi macOS, CI Linux):</p><pre>tofu providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=darwin_arm64</pre><p>Aks holda CI'da <code>the current package doesn't match any of the checksums</code> xatosi.</p><h4>Qo'shimcha</h4><ul><li>Ichki/air-gapped muhit: provider <b>mirror</b> (<code>tofu providers mirror</code>) — internetsiz, oldindan tekshirilgan binary'lar.</li><li><code>.terraform.lock.hcl</code>ni <code>.gitignore</code>ga qo'shish — keng tarqalgan xato, himoyani yo'qqa chiqaradi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Imzo &quot;kim chiqargan&quot;ni isbotlaydi, &quot;xavfsiz&quot;ligini emas — community provider'lar ham imzolanadi. Provider tanlashda manba, ta'minotchi va versiyani pin qilish (<code>~&gt;</code> bilan major qotirish) birga muhim.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41323	<p>Terraform modulini semantic versioning bilan qotirish nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Modulni <b>aniq versiyaga</b> bog'lash — kod har safar sinovdan o'tgan bir xil modul nusxasini ishlatadi. Busiz modul muallifi yangi o'zgarish chiqarganda, keyingi <code>init</code> uni avtomatik yuklaydi va production'da kutilmagan <code>destroy</code> paydo bo'lishi mumkin.</p><h4>Semantic versioning — <code>MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH</code></h4><ul><li><b>MAJOR</b> (<code>5.0.0</code> -&gt; <code>6.0.0</code>) — <b>breaking change</b>: input nomi o'zgardi, resurs qayta yaratiladi.</li><li><b>MINOR</b> (<code>5.1</code> -&gt; <code>5.2</code>) — yangi imkoniyat, orqaga mos.</li><li><b>PATCH</b> (<code>5.1.0</code> -&gt; <code>5.1.1</code>) — bug fix.</li></ul><h4>Pin qilish</h4><p>Registry moduli:</p><pre>module &quot;vpc&quot; {<br>  source  = &quot;terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws&quot;<br>  version = &quot;5.1.0&quot;        # aniq versiya<br>  # version = &quot;~&gt; 5.1&quot;     # 5.1.x va 5.x — lekin 6.0 emas<br>}</pre><p>Git moduli (<code>version</code> atributi ishlamaydi — <code>ref</code> ishlatiladi):</p><pre>module &quot;eks&quot; {<br>  source = &quot;git::https://github.com/org/tf-modules.git//eks?ref=v2.3.1&quot;<br>}</pre><p><code>ref=main</code> — pin <b>emas</b>: har init boshqa kod.</p><h4>Qaysi constraint qachon</h4><p>| Constraint | Ma'nosi | Qachon | |---|---|---| | <code>= 5.1.0</code> | aynan shu | production live konfiguratsiya | | <code>~&gt; 5.1.0</code> | 5.1.x (patch'lar) | xavfsiz avtomatik bug fix | | <code>~&gt; 5.1</code> | 5.x | modul ichidan boshqa modulga | | <code>&gt;= 5.0</code> | har qanday yangi | <b>ishlatmang</b> |</p><h4>Yangilash jarayoni</h4><ol><li>Changelog'ni o'qish (ayniqsa major).</li><li>Versiyani PR'da o'zgartirish.</li><li><code>terraform plan</code> — <code>-/+</code> (replace) va <code>destroy</code> yo'qligini tekshirish.</li><li>Avval dev/stage, keyin prod.</li></ol><p>Renovate/Dependabot yangi versiyalar uchun avtomatik PR ochadi.</p><h4>Modul muallifi sifatida</h4><ul><li>Har release'ga Git tag (<code>v2.3.1</code>).</li><li>Major'da <code>moved {}</code> bloklari — resurs nomi o'zgarsa, qayta yaratish o'rniga state'da ko'chirish.</li><li>CHANGELOG va migratsiya qo'llanmasi.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Provider'lar uchun ham xuddi shunday: <code>required_providers</code>da <code>~&gt; 5.0</code> + commit qilingan <code>.terraform.lock.hcl</code>. Pin qilinmagan modul va provider — &quot;kecha ishlagan, bugun ishlamayapti&quot; turidagi incidentlarning asosiy manbai.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41324	<p>HCL'da <code>merge()</code> va <code>concat()</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>merge()</code> — <b>map/object</b>larni birlashtiradi; bir xil kalit bo'lsa <b>oxirgisi yutadi</b>. <code>concat()</code> — <b>list</b>larni ketma-ket ulaydi; takrorlanishlar saqlanadi.</p><h4>merge — default + override</h4><pre>locals {<br>  common_tags = { Team = &quot;platform&quot;, ManagedBy = &quot;terraform&quot;, Env = &quot;dev&quot; }<br>  extra_tags  = { Env = &quot;prod&quot;, CostCenter = &quot;42&quot; }<br><br>  tags = merge(local.common_tags, local.extra_tags)<br>  # { Team = &quot;platform&quot;, ManagedBy = &quot;terraform&quot;, Env = &quot;prod&quot;, CostCenter = &quot;42&quot; }<br>}</pre><p><code>Env</code> ikkalasida — o'ngdagisi (<code>prod</code>) qoldi. Bu pattern: <b>default'lar chapda, maxsus qiymatlar o'ngda</b>.</p><p><b>Muhim:</b> <code>merge</code> <b>sayoz</b> (shallow). Ichki map'lar birlashtirilmaydi, butunlay almashtiriladi:</p><pre>merge({ a = { x = 1, y = 2 } }, { a = { y = 3 } })<br># = { a = { y = 3 } }   &lt;- x yo'qoldi!</pre><p>Chuqur birlashtirish uchun ichki darajani alohida <code>merge</code> qilish kerak.</p><h4>concat — list'larni ulash</h4><pre>locals {<br>  base_cidrs  = [&quot;10.0.0.0/8&quot;]<br>  office_cidr = [&quot;203.0.113.0/24&quot;]<br>  allowed     = concat(local.base_cidrs, local.office_cidr, var.extra_cidrs)<br>  # [&quot;10.0.0.0/8&quot;, &quot;203.0.113.0/24&quot;, ...]<br>}</pre><p>Takrorlanishni olib tashlash: <code>distinct(concat(a, b))</code>. Ichki list'larni tekislash: <code>flatten([a, [b, c]])</code>.</p><h4>Jadval</h4><p>| | <code>merge</code> | <code>concat</code> | |---|---|---| | Kirish | map / object | list / tuple | | Takror kalit | oxirgisi yutadi | ikkalasi qoladi | | Tartib | ahamiyatsiz (map) | saqlanadi | | Chuqurlik | sayoz | — |</p><h4>Odatiy tuzoq</h4><p><code>merge</code>ga list yoki <code>concat</code>ga map berish — tur xatosi. Ichki map'li sozlamalarni <code>merge</code> qilib, ichki kalitlar &quot;yo'qolishi&quot; — eng ko'p uchraydigan bug.</p><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> AWS provider'da tag'lar uchun <code>merge</code> o'rniga provider darajasidagi <code>default_tags</code> blokini ishlating — har resursda <code>merge(local.tags, ...)</code> takrorlanmaydi va hech biri unutilmaydi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::iac sec::h21 Advanced_Terraform_Terragrunt
Interview Drill::IaC::H21 Advanced Terraform & Terragrunt	idrill-41325	<p>Terraform custom provider yaratish nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Custom provider — Terraform'ga <b>sizning API'ingizni</b> (ichki platforma, ichki DNS, SaaS) boshqarishni o'rgatadigan Go dasturi.  terraform-provider-myapi (Go binary)  --HTTP--&gt;  Sizning API<br>  plan/state/diff        CRUD funksiyalari</pre><h4>Resurs skeleti (Plugin Framework)</h4><pre>type serverResource struct{ client *api.Client }<br><br>type serverModel struct {<br>    ID   types.String `tfsdk:&quot;id&quot;`<br>    Name types.String `tfsdk:&quot;name&quot;`<br>    Size types.String `tfsdk:&quot;size&quot;`<br>}<br><br>func (r *serverResource) Schema(_ context.Context, _ resource.SchemaRequest, resp *resource.SchemaResponse) {<br>    resp.Schema = schema.Schema{Attributes: map[string]schema.Attribute{<br>        &quot;id&quot;:   schema.StringAttribute{Computed: true},<br>        &quot;name&quot;: schema.StringAttribute{Required: true,<br>            PlanModifiers: []planmodifier.String{stringplanmodifier.RequiresReplace()}},<br>        &quot;size&quot;: schema.StringAttribute{Required: true},<br>    }}<br>}<br><br>func (r *serverResource) Create(ctx context.Context, req resource.CreateRequest, resp *resource.CreateResponse) {<br>    var plan serverModel<br>    resp.Diagnostics.Append(req.Plan.Get(ctx, &amp;plan)...)<br>    if resp.Diagnostics.HasError() { return }<br><br>    srv, err := r.client.CreateServer(ctx, plan.Name.ValueString(), plan.Size.ValueString())<br>    if err != nil {<br>        resp.Diagnostics.AddError(&quot;server yaratilmadi&quot;, err.Error())<br>        return<br>    }<br>    plan.ID = types.StringValue(srv.ID)<br>    resp.Diagnostics.Append(resp.State.Set(ctx, plan)...)<br>}<br>// Read, Update, Delete — xuddi shunday</pre><h4>Har funksiya vazifasi</h4><ul><li><b>Schema</b> — atributlar: <code>Required</code>, <code>Optional</code>, <code>Computed</code> (API qaytaradi), <code>Sensitive</code>. <code>RequiresReplace</code> — o'zgarsa resurs qayta yaratiladi.</li><li><b>Create</b> — API'da yaratish, ID'ni state'ga yozish.</li><li><b>Read</b> — refresh paytida haqiqiy holatni olish. Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41711	<p>PromQL'da error rate foizini qanday hisoblaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Error rate = <b>xatoli so'rovlar tezligi / barcha so'rovlar tezligi</b>. Ikkalasi ham counter, shuning uchun avval <code>rate()</code> bilan &quot;sekundiga nechta&quot; ga aylantiriladi, keyin bo'linadi.</p><h4>So'rov</h4><pre>sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m]))<br>/<br>sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))<br>* 100</pre><h4>Qatorma-qator</h4><ol><li><code>http_requests_total</code> — <b>counter</b>: faqat o'sadi (restart'da 0 ga tushadi). Uning xom qiymati (masalan 1 234 567) foydasiz — bizga o'zgarish tezligi kerak.</li><li><code>rate(...[5m])</code> — oxirgi 5 daqiqada sekundiga o'rtacha nechta so'rov. Counter reset'ni o'zi to'g'ri hisoblaydi.</li><li><code>{status=~&quot;5..&quot;}</code> — regex: 500-599 kodlar. 4xx odatda <b>client xatosi</b> — servis aybi emas, SLO'ga qo'shilmaydi.</li><li><code>sum(...)</code> — barcha pod/instance'lar bo'yicha yig'ish. <code>sum</code>siz har pod alohida chiqadi va bo'linishda label'lar mos kelmasa natija bo'sh bo'ladi.</li><li>Bo'lish va <code>* 100</code> — foiz.</li></ol><h4>Servis bo'yicha</h4><pre>sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{status=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m]))<br>/<br>sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))</pre><p>Ikkala tomonda <b>bir xil</b> <code>by (...)</code> bo'lishi shart — aks holda label'lar mos kelmaydi.</p><h4>Alert misoli</h4><pre>- alert: HighErrorRate<br>  expr: |<br>    sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{status=~&quot;5..&quot;}[5m]))<br>    / sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total[5m])) &gt; 0.05<br>  for: 10m</pre><p><code>for: 10m</code> — qisqa sakrashda alert chiqmasin.</p><h4>Tuzoqlar</h4><ul><li>Trafik juda kam (kechasi 2 so'rov, 1 tasi xato) — 50% error rate, yolg'on alert. Yechim: minimal trafik sharti qo'shish (<code>and sum(rate(...)) &gt; 1</code>).</li><li>Trafik 0 bo'lsa — 0/0 = <code>NaN</code>, alert ishlamaydi.</li><li><code>rate()</code> oynasi scrape interval'dan kamida 4x katta bo'lsin (15s scrape — <code>[1m]</code>+).</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Production'da bu so'rov <b>recording rule</b> sifatida oldindan hisoblanadi (<code>job:http_errors:ratio_rate5m</code>) va SLO uchun bir nechta oynada (5m, 1h, 6h) <b>multi-window burn-rate</b> alert'lari quriladi — oddiy threshold'dan ancha kam shovqin beradi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h27 PromQL_tracing
Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41712	<p>Kubernetes'da container CPU foizini (limit'ga nisbatan) PromQL bilan qanday hisoblaysiz?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Container ishlatgan CPU tezligini uning <b>CPU limiti</b>ga bo'lamiz. Ishlatish — cAdvisor metrikasi (<code>container_cpu_usage_seconds_total</code>), limit — kube-state-metrics metrikasi (<code>kube_pod_container_resource_limits</code>).</p><h4>So'rov</h4><pre>sum by (namespace, pod) (<br>  rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!=&quot;&quot;, container!=&quot;POD&quot;}[5m])<br>)<br>/<br>sum by (namespace, pod) (<br>  kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource=&quot;cpu&quot;}<br>)<br>* 100</pre><h4>Qatorma-qator</h4><ol><li><code>container_cpu_usage_seconds_total</code> — container ishlatgan <b>CPU-sekundlar</b> counter'i. <code>rate()</code> dan keyin u &quot;<b>nechta yadro</b> ishlatilyapti&quot; degan son bo'ladi: <code>0.5</code> = yarim yadro.</li><li><code>container!=&quot;&quot;</code> — pod darajasidagi umumiy (agregat) qatorni chiqarib tashlaydi, aks holda ikki marta sanaladi.</li><li><code>container!=&quot;POD&quot;</code> — &quot;pause&quot; container (pod'ning tarmoq namespace'ini ushlab turuvchi) — keraksiz.</li><li><code>kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource=&quot;cpu&quot;}</code> — limit <b>yadrolarda</b> (<code>500m</code> = <code>0.5</code>).</li><li>Ikkala tomon <code>by (namespace, pod)</code> — label'lar mos kelishi uchun. Ikki xil manba (cAdvisor va kube-state-metrics) bo'lgani uchun boshqa label'lar (<code>instance</code>, <code>job</code>) farq qiladi — <code>sum by</code> ularni olib tashlaydi.</li></ol><p>Natija 100% ga yaqin — container limitga urilyapti, <b>throttling</b> boshlanadi.</p><h4>Limit yo'q bo'lsa</h4><p>Limitsiz pod'larda o'ng tomon bo'sh — natijada ular umuman ko'rinmaydi. Request'ga nisbatan hisoblash:</p><pre>... / sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource=&quot;cpu&quot;}) * 100</pre><p>Request'ga nisbatan 100% dan oshishi normal (limit yo'q, bo'sh CPU'ni ishlatyapti).</p><h4>Throttling'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'lchash</h4><p>O'rtacha CPU 60% bo'lsa ham throttling bo'lishi mumkin (qisqa burst'lar). Aniqroq:</p><pre>sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total[5m]))<br>/ sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total[5m]))</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> CPU % o'zi yolg'iz kam ma'no beradi — latency'ga ta'sir qiladigan narsa <b>throttling</b>. Dashboard'da ikkalasini yonma-yon qo'ying.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h27 PromQL_tracing
Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41713	<p>PromQL'da <code>increase()</code> va <code>rate()</code> farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Ikkalasi ham counter'ning oyna ichidagi o'sishini hisoblaydi. <code>rate()</code> — <b>sekundiga</b> o'rtacha o'sish (tezlik). <code>increase()</code> — oyna davomida <b>jami</b> o'sish. Aslida <code>increase(x[1h]) = rate(x[1h]) * 3600</code>.</p><h4>Misol</h4><p><code>http_requests_total</code> 1 soat ichida 36 000 ga o'sdi:</p><ul><li><code>rate(http_requests_total[1h])</code> = <b>10</b> (sekundiga 10 so'rov)</li><li><code>increase(http_requests_total[1h])</code> = <b>36 000</b> (soatda jami)</li></ul><h4>Qachon qaysi</h4><ul><li><b><code>rate()</code></b> — grafiklar, alert'lar, nisbatlar (error rate, RPS). Oyna o'lchami o'zgarsa ham qiymat bir xil ma'noda — taqqoslash oson.</li><li><b><code>increase()</code></b> — odam o'qiydigan &quot;jami&quot; son: &quot;oxirgi 24 soatda nechta buyurtma&quot;, &quot;bugun nechta xato&quot;.</li></ul><h4>Nega <code>increase()</code> butun son bermaydi</h4><p>Counter butun son bo'lsa ham, <code>increase()</code> <code>10.5</code> kabi qaytarishi mumkin. Sabab — <b>ekstrapolyatsiya</b>: scrape'lar oyna chegarasiga aniq to'g'ri kelmaydi (masalan 1 soatlik oynada birinchi namuna 14s kech). Prometheus mavjud namunalar orasidagi o'sishni butun oynaga cho'zadi. Bu xato emas — statistik baho.</p><h4>Counter reset</h4><p>Ikkalasi ham restart'ni (counter 0 ga tushishi) to'g'ri qayta ishlaydi: kamayishni &quot;reset&quot; deb tushunadi va qo'shib hisoblaydi. Shuning uchun counter'ga hech qachon oddiy ayirish (<code>x - x offset 1h</code>) ishlatmang.</p><h4><code>irate()</code> — uchinchisi</h4><p><code>irate()</code> faqat oxirgi <b>ikki</b> namuna bo'yicha — juda &quot;asabiy&quot;, tez o'zgarishlarni ko'rsatadi. Alert va recording rule uchun emas, faqat zoom qilingan grafik uchun.</p><h4>Muhim qoida</h4><p>Avval <code>rate</code>, keyin <code>sum</code>:</p><pre>sum(rate(x[5m]))     # TO'G'RI<br>rate(sum(x)[5m])     # NOTO'G'RI — sum reset'larni yashiradi</pre><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Oyna kamida 4 ta scrape'ni qamrab olishi kerak (15s scrape = <code>[1m]</code> minimum). Juda kichik oynada namuna yetmaydi va grafik &quot;teshik&quot; bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h27 PromQL_tracing
Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41714	<p>PromQL vector matching (<code>on()</code>, <code>ignoring()</code>, <code>group_left()</code>, <code>group_right()</code>) nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> PromQL'da ikki vektor ustida arifmetika (<code>/</code>, <code>*</code>, <code>+</code>) qilinganda Prometheus qatorlarni <b>label'lari bir xil</b> bo'yicha juftlaydi. Label'lar to'liq mos kelmasa natija bo'sh. Vector matching kalit so'zlari qaysi label'lar bo'yicha moslashni va &quot;bittaga ko'p&quot; munosabatni boshqaradi.</p><h4>Muammo</h4><pre>container_memory_usage_bytes / kube_pod_container_resource_limits</pre><p>Natija bo'sh — chunki chapda <code>instance=&quot;node1:10250&quot;, job=&quot;kubelet&quot;</code>, o'ngda <code>instance=&quot;ksm:8080&quot;, job=&quot;kube-state-metrics&quot;</code>. Label to'plamlari farq qiladi.</p><h4><code>on()</code> va <code>ignoring()</code> — qaysi label'lar bo'yicha</h4><pre>a / on(namespace, pod) b          # FAQAT shu label'lar bo'yicha juftla<br>a / ignoring(instance, job) b     # shu label'lardan TASHQARI hammasi bo'yicha</pre><h4><code>group_left</code> / <code>group_right</code> — bittaga ko'p</h4><p>Default — <b>bittaga bitta</b>. Bir tomonda bir xil kalit uchun bir nechta qator bo'lsa xato: <code>many-to-many matching not allowed</code>.</p><ul><li><code>group_left</code> — <b>chap</b> tomonda ko'p qator, o'ngda bitta.</li><li><code>group_right</code> — teskari.</li></ul><h4>Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan holat — label qo'shish</h4><p>Metrikada <code>node</code> label'i yo'q, lekin uni ko'rsatish kerak. <code>kube_pod_info</code> da bor (qiymati doim <code>1</code>):</p><pre>sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[5m]))<br>* on(namespace, pod) group_left(node)<br>kube_pod_info</pre><ul><li><code>on(namespace, pod)</code> — pod bo'yicha juftlash.</li><li><code>group_left(node)</code> — chapdagi har qatorga o'ngdan <code>node</code> label'ini <b>ko'chirib</b> qo'yish.</li><li><code>* 1</code> — qiymat o'zgarmaydi, faqat label qo'shiladi.</li></ul><p>Bu &quot;info metric&quot; pattern: deploy versiyasi (<code>app_build_info</code>), node rollari va h.k. shu usulda qo'shiladi.</p><h4>Tez-tez xatolar</h4><ul><li><code>group_left</code> qo'yilgan, lekin o'ng tomonda ham bir kalitga ikki qator (pod restart'da eski va yangi <code>kube_pod_info</code>) — <code>duplicate series</code> xatosi. Yechim: o'ng tomonni <code>max by (...)</code> bilan bir qatorga tushirish.</li><li><code>on()</code> ga label'ni unutish — noto'g'ri juftlash yoki bo'sh natija.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Bo'sh natija PromQL'da eng ko'p uchraydigan &quot;bug&quot;. Avval har ikki tomonni alohida ishga tushirib, label'larini solishtiring — sabab deyarli doim mos kelmagan label.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h27 PromQL_tracing
Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41715	<p>OTel Collector'da xatolarni ushlash uchun tail-based sampling qanday sozlanadi?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Tail-based sampling — trace <b>tugagandan keyin</b>, uning to'liq tarkibini ko'rib, saqlash yoki tashlashni hal qilish. Shuning uchun &quot;xatoli yoki sekin trace'larni 100%, qolganlarini 5% saqla&quot; degan qoida mumkin. Head-based sampling buni qila olmaydi — u trace boshida, natija noma'lum paytda qaror qiladi.</p><h4>Muammo</h4><p>Sekundiga 50 000 span — hammasini saqlash juda qimmat. 1% random sampling qilsangiz, eng qiziq trace'lar (xatolar, sekinlar — juda kam) asosan <b>tashlanadi</b>.</p><h4>Sozlama</h4><pre>processors:<br>  tail_sampling:<br>    decision_wait: 10s              # trace'ning barcha span'larini shuncha kutish<br>    num_traces: 100000              # xotirada bir vaqtda ushlanadigan trace'lar<br>    expected_new_traces_per_sec: 2000<br>    policies:<br>      - name: errors<br>        type: status_code<br>        status_code: { status_codes: [ERROR] }<br>      - name: slow<br>        type: latency<br>        latency: { threshold_ms: 2000 }<br>      - name: baseline<br>        type: probabilistic<br>        probabilistic: { sampling_percentage: 5 }<br><br>service:<br>  pipelines:<br>    traces:<br>      receivers: [otlp]<br>      processors: [tail_sampling, batch]<br>      exporters: [otlp/tempo]</pre><h4>Qanday ishlaydi</h4><ol><li>Span'lar keladi, Collector ularni trace ID bo'yicha xotirada guruhlaydi.</li><li>Birinchi span'dan <code>decision_wait</code> (10s) o'tgach — trace &quot;tugagan&quot; hisoblanadi.</li><li>Policy'lar tekshiriladi. <b>Birortasi</b> &quot;saqla&quot; desa — saqlanadi (OR mantiq).</li><li>Natija: hamma xatolar + hamma 2s+ trace'lar + qolganlardan 5%.</li></ol><h4>Muhim arxitektura talabi</h4><p>Bitta trace'ning <b>barcha</b> span'lari <b>bitta</b> Collector instance'ga kelishi shart — aks holda har instance trace'ning bir qismini ko'radi va noto'g'ri qaror qiladi. Yechim — ikki qatlam:</p><pre>servislar -&gt; Collector (1-qatlam, loadbalancing exporter, routing_key: traceID)<br>          -&gt; Collector (2-qatlam, tail_sampling) -&gt; Tempo/Jaeger</pre><h4>Narxi</h4><ul><li>Xotira: <code>decision_wait</code> x trace oqimi. 10s x 2000 trace/s = 20 000 trace xotirada.</li><li><code>decision_wait</code>dan kech kelgan span'lar yo'qoladi — uzoq async ishlar uchun oynani kattalashtiring.</li></ul><p><b>Senior nuqta:</b> Ko'pincha ikkalasi birga: SDK'da yengil head sampling (masalan 50%) yukni kamaytiradi, Collector'da tail sampling qiymatli trace'larni tanlaydi. Saqlanmagan trace'lar uchun RED metrikalarni <b>sampling'dan oldin</b> (spanmetrics connector) hisoblang — aks holda metrikalar ham noto'g'ri bo'ladi.</p>	lvl::Senior dom::obs sec::h27 PromQL_tracing
Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41716	<p>OTel TraceIdRatioBased sampler nima?</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> <code>TraceIdRatioBased</code> — OpenTelemetry SDK'dagi <b>head-based</b> sampler: trace boshlanayotganda trace ID'ga qarab belgilangan foizni (masalan 10%) saqlaydi. Lekin random son emas, ID'ning o'zi ishlatiladi — shuning uchun qayta hisoblansa ham natija o'zgarmaydi.</p><h4>Nega ParentBased kerak</h4><p>Trace 5 ta servisdan o'tadi. Interview Drill::Observability::H27 PromQL & tracing	idrill-41718	<p>Thanos Querier va Thanos Store Gateway farqi.</p>	<p><b>Qisqa javob:</b> Thanos — Prometheus'ni uzoq muddatli saqlash va global ko'rinishga kengaytiradi. <b>Querier</b> — foydalanuvchi so'rovini qabul qilib, hamma manbalardan ma'lumot yig'adigan <b>so'rov dvigateli</b>. <b>Store Gateway</b> — object storage'dagi (S3) <b>eski block'larni</b> o'qib beradigan manba.
